notes.title: Patch notes - 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hello!
This is a small patch that fix Ruinen (4th mission in Axis Campaign):


Reduced the damage of the enemies in the city.
More health kits added.


Hope this get the mission a little easier. Thank you!

Terfilis

notes.title: Patch notes - 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello! This is the list of improvements in this new update:


 The order of the missions has been changed to make the campaigns easier at the beginning.
 Added feedback when you hit an enemy.
 Added settings menu while playing a mission.
 Balanced difficulty.


Terfilis
